notes: The supplied appositional *even* was marked `added` on rule 105's default, but rule 105 settles only two carrier classes and `Ἰησοῦν` is neither: it is a bare anarthrous name in apposition, with no preposition and no substantival article carrying it. The corpus has exactly this shape at JHN.5.45, `Μωϋσῆς` → *even Moses*, `aligned` and headed on the name, unhedged. Rule 105's `added` branch rests on rule 32's *and nothing else*, which restricts an article and cannot bind a name, so rule 7's ordinary fold applies and *even* belongs to the word it introduces. Every other unit of the verse is unchanged.
